scope: One actual 30-frame, native-60-FPS worker/model and saved-result compatibility smoke. No independent labels, accuracy, full-match capacity or deployment qualification.

originReceipt.reuse: Cloned genuine worker/input/normalization/reporting/owned-monitor checks. Fresh paths and initial source-hash gate; no fabricated observer revision.
originReceipt.retryPolicy: Explicit root-reviewed fresh launch only after other workloads finish and independently observed headroom recovers. Both unchanged 2.5 GB preflight checks run again; no automatic retry.

conditionalFreshLaunch: Manually reviewed after other workloads complete and headroom recovers; unchanged preflight rechecks. First consumed attempt is retained. No automatic retry.
retention: Retain all owned logs, partial outputs and receipts. No retry or unrelated cleanup.

jobs.error: The video could not be decoded or encoded. Check disk space, export a playable MP4 and try again.

liveProductFileTreeBefore.scope: Every live product file byte/hash, including SQLite sidecars, and directory names. Read-only; any change prevents a passing receipt.
